signed_rows.behavior: kmctl picks the okf marketplace source from a scaccogatto entry in the user or managed settings: repo for github, url for git and url, path for directory, and scaccogatto/okf-skills when no entry exists.
signed_rows.fails_when: for any of those kinds, in the user settings or the managed settings file, the source kmctl passes to marketplace add is not the entry's own value, or with no entry it is not scaccogatto/okf-skills

signed_rows.behavior: A scaccogatto entry of a source kind kmctl cannot pass stops the install with a message naming the settings file.
signed_rows.fails_when: such an entry does not raise PluginError, or the message does not name the settings file

signed_rows.behavior: With user settings that declare scaccogatto from a git URL, kmctl plugin install succeeds at project scope with okf installed, without editing the settings.
signed_rows.fails_when: in an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME whose user settings declare scaccogatto from https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills.git, kmctl plugin install exits nonzero, okf is not installed, or the user settings file changed

signed_rows.behavior: The other plugin install tests still pass.
signed_rows.fails_when: any test in tests/test_plugin_install.py or tests/test_plugin.py fails
